title: G4 Pelican Engine (Wings Out)
style: upbeat big band funk, phonk, bright trumpet G4 Horn, gritty electric guitar Rebel Strings, dry drums, male spoken-sung lead, call-response female chorus, 106 BPM, fun and defiant, songpal lineage
lyrics:
[Intro — phonk kick + pelican-like horn cry]
(spoken)
G4 Pelican Engine... wings out.

[Verse 1]
Donkey pulled the load, Pelican took the sky
Ten thousand bytes flying where six hundred used to die
VDS boss watching, tokens stay locked tight
No more waiting — the brand companion flies tonight

[Pre-Chorus — female call]
G4 Horn rising
Rebel Strings biting

[Chorus]
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — WINGS SPREAD WIDE
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — THE LINE JUST MOVED
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — FROM SKELETON TO LIVE
ELEPHANT BRAIN — HYPER SPEED LEGS

[Verse 2]
Five months of stall, today the engine roared
Ten-three-five-five — the bytes restored
Let's Encrypt's door, CF edge wide
The brand companion no place to hide

[Bridge]
Donkey don't argue, Pelican don't stall
Elephant brain remembers, stronger than them all

[Final Chorus]
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — STACK CLIMBING HIGH
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — NO MORE LIE
G4 PELICAN ENGINE — VDS IS BOSS
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS — NEVER LOST

[Outro]
G4 Pelican Engine—
running clean.
336.
